Rule: As an action, the captain gives an order: one ally within 6 inches may move up to 3 inches at once
As a Use action, every ally within 6 inches loses their **Shook** and **Flustered** tokens
When the captain puts an enemy down, every ally within 3 inches of them is **Hyped**
The captain's breaking test has +1 die, and allies within 3 inches of the captain cannot be **Flustered**
When the captain is attacked, they may spend their reaction to swap places with an ally within 2 inches, who becomes the target instead. Leadership is knowing who to send
One downed ally within 3 inches of the captain when the battle ends rolls the **gentle** injury table, even if the crew left them behind (the captain went back for them)
After both sides deploy, the captain's player may move up to two of their fighters, staying in the deployment zone
The crew may swear one more Word each battle; it must be the captain's, and a Boast. It stacks with the Showboats tag (section 14.10)
Old-stock items are found on a **3+** instead of a 4+
After each battle, if the crew has fewer than three contacts, it gains one **contact** (section 14.8) of the player's choice
Work a job pays **+2 parts** for every fighter of the crew who takes it
When the captain teaches Train (section 14.6), a success gives the trainee **+1 XP** more
